digest.component_or_area: CloudWatch alarms and SNS notification wiring in Terraform infrastructure
propositions: voter_errors alarm and replication_errors alarm declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, so OK→ALARM transitions fire silently with no operator notification

11 of 13 aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks in infra/terraform/ wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn; these two are the only omissions and violate the established repo convention
alarm headers claim they surface broken conditions to operators, but empty actions prevent any notification delivery, making the claims false
guard test added to fail on any aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm lacking alarm_actions with anti-vacuity assertion and mandatory explicit opt-out marker, preventing silent alarms from shipping
change merged to main but still un-applied; live describe-alarms after merge still shows AlarmActions: [] and OKActions: [], proving HCL-only does not activate production notifications

terraform apply executed; alarms now show AlarmActions and OKActions pointing to confirmed SNS subscription (joeoakhart@navapbc.com), with end-to-end notification proven by forced alarm state transition
